title: Jagannathashtakam
intro: Jagannathashtakam is a famous hymn dedicated to Lord Jagannath. Read the complete lyrics, meaning, and benefits.
description:
kadaachit-kalindi tativipina sangeetakaravo
mudaabheeri naarivadana kamalaswaadamadhupah ।
rama shambhu brahmamarapati ganesharchita pado
jagannathah swami nayanapathagaami bhavatu me || 1 ||

bhuje savye venum shirasi shikhipincham katitate
dukoolam netrante sahacharakataksham vidadhate ।
sada shrimadvrindavanavasatileelaparichayo
jagannathah swami nayanapathagaami bhavatu me || 2 ||

mahambhodhestire kanakaruchire neelashikhare
vasan prasadantassahaja balabhadrena balina ।
subhadra madhyasthassakalasura sevasavasarado
jagannathah swami nayanapathagaami bhavatu me || 3 ||

kripaa pararavarassajala jalada shreniruchiro
ramavani ramasphuradamala pankeruhamukhah ।
surendrairaradhyah shrutigandashikha geeta charito
jagannathah swami nayanapathagaami bhavatu me || 4 ||

ratharudho gachchan pathi milita bhudevapatalaih
stuti pradurbhavam pratipadamupakarnya sadayah ।
dayasindhurbandhussakala jagata sindhusutaya
jagannathah swami nayanapathagaami bhavatu me || 5 ||

parabrahmapidah kuvalaya-dalotphullanayano
nivasi neeladrau nihita-charano'nanta-shirasi ।
rasanando radha-saras-vapuralingana-sakho
jagannathah swami nayanapathagaami bhavatu me || 6 ||

na vai yaache rajyam na cha kanaka manikya vibhavam
na yaache'ham ramyam nikhilajana-kaamyam varavadhum ।
sada kale kale pramatha-patina geetacharito
jagannathah swami nayanapathagaami bhavatu me || 7 ||

hara tvam samsaram drutataramasaram surapate
hara tvam papanam vitatimaparam yadavapate ।
aho dinonathe nihitacharano nishchitamidam
jagannathah swami nayanapathagaami bhavatu me || 8 ||

jagannathashtakam punyam yah pathet prayatah shuchih ।
sarvapapa vishuddhatma vishnulokam sa gachchhati ||

iti shrimad shankaracharyavirachitam jagannathashtakam sampurnam ||

faq.a1: It was composed by the founder of Advaita Vedanta and great philosopher, Adi Guru Shankaracharya.
faq.q2: What is the main purpose and significance of Jagannathashtakam?
faq.a2: This stotra is dedicated to the supremely beautiful form of Lord Jagannath (Lord Krishna), His pastimes, and the glory of Puri Dham (Neelachal). In it, a constant prayer is made that Lord Jagannath may become the guest of our path of vision ("Nayanapathagaami Bhavatu Me").
faq.q3: How many verses are there in this stotra?
faq.a3: Jagannathashtakam contains a total of 8 verses of praise, followed by a phalashruti verse at the end.
faq.q4: What are the benefits of reciting Jagannathashtakam?
faq.a4: Regular and sacred recitation of this stotra destroys all the sins of the seeker and ultimately grants them the abode of Lord Vishnu (Vishnulok).
faq.q5: When should this stotra be recited?
faq.a5: Reciting it daily during morning worship or on special occasions such as Rath Yatra, Purnima, and during the darshan of Lord Jagannath is considered extremely auspicious.
